labelChirho: housetop, flat roof of a building
descriptionChirho: The flat roof or rooftop of a house, characteristic of ancient Near Eastern architecture, used as an accessible outdoor space for prayer, proclamation, or lowering objects; rendered 'housetop/roof' (eng), 'terrado/azotea/techo' (spa), 'छत/छतों' (hin), 'سطح/سطوح' (arb), '지붕' (kor), 'dari/paa' (swa). All seven occurrences across singular genitive, singular accusative, and genitive plural forms denote the same architectural feature with no semantic differentiation between the three clusters.
